license_match_note: permit_rows_with_license_match counts permit rows whose printed contractor name exactly matches a Delaware business contractor license name. It is a name match, not an identity check. with_last_roof_license_active counts parcels whose last roof contractor matches a license valid on the query date.
contractor_count_note: with_any_permit_contractor counts parcels whose latest permit of any type prints a name. with_last_roof_contractor counts parcels whose latest roof-work permit prints a name, from the closed and new-construction layers. The open-permit layer prints a contractor on only a few rows, so neither count is an open-permit contractor.
